data.description: User must affix it to a non-magical hat worth at least 10 gp. 1/day, when the wearer performs a deed, the plume provides her with 1 panache point that can be used for that deed. Once used the plume appears bedraggled until its magic is replenished.
data.name: Plume of Panache
